value.rationale: Strand-invariant self-synchronizing binary markers are a natural joint design constraint not guaranteed by unrestricted cross-bifix-free constructions. Complete all-length feasibility with three sharp exceptions and a constructive asymptotic rate-one lower bound settle structural availability and capacity in a way neither a single tiny code nor a routine table gives. The polynomial size gap and lack of noise correction are explicit limitations.
